name: @hooksjam/pixi-lab
description: Game & Simulation Lab — core engine, React integration, content packages

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-core build && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-react build && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-games build && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-simulations build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-react typecheck && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-games typecheck && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-simulations typecheck && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-demo typecheck
scripts.pack:dry-run: pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-core pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-react pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-games pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-simulations pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-core publish --dry-run --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-react publish --dry-run --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-games publish --dry-run --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-simulations publish --dry-run --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:packages: pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-core publish --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-react publish --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-games publish --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @hooksjam/pixi-lab-simulations publish --no-git-checks
